title: EPICS: Efficient Parallel Pattern Fault Simulation for Sequential Circuits via Strongly Connected Components
problem: Gate-level fault simulation for large sequential circuits is time-consuming; existing parallel-pattern techniques fail for sequential circuits due to timing dependencies within feedback loops (strongly connected components).
motivation: Functional safety standards (ISO 26262) mandate high diagnostic fault coverage; accelerating fault simulation reduces chip verification time.
method: EPICS combines loop fusion (compiling simple loops into larger nodes) with event-driven simulation; selects loop entrance nodes via indegree analysis for larger SCCs; implements lazy propagation for internal nodes; strategically mixes compiled and event-driven modes.
key_novelty: Loop fusion and SCC-aware parallel-pattern simulation for sequential circuits, enabling safe cycle-parallel execution without dependency violations.
contributions: 5.94x speedup over commercial tools while maintaining fault coverage
Loop fusion reduces feedback events without excessive redundancy
Lazy propagation minimizes false event propagation overhead
primary_theme: Parallel fault simulation for sequential circuits via SCC-aware loop fusion
